One thing I’d add: observability tells us what the agent did. Enterprise readiness also depends on deciding what the agent is allowed to decide before it acts. An agent can be fully authenticated, monitored and compliant and still make the wrong call. The harder questions are: When must it stop? What requires escalation? Can the action be reversed? That may be where agent platforms and operating models start to converge.
